children: ENGIE S.A. (EURONEXT:ENGI) and Belgium target Dec. 12 for an agreement on transferring its nuclear assets, though valuation differences remain. ENGIE reported a larger-than-expected increase in net debt, driven by higher energy commodity costs.
: ENGIE S.A. and Belgium extended talks on transferring its nuclear assets, setting Dec. 12 as the target for an agreement. Progress was reported, but valuation differences remain.

: ENGIE S.A. (ENGI) reported a larger-than-expected increase in net debt, driven by higher energy commodity costs, which required greater margin-call payments and increased spending on gas inventories.
: ENGIE completed refinancing for Oman’s Barka 3 and Sohar 2 gas plants, each with 744 MW of capacity, after extending power purchase agreements by 15 years through 2043.
: ENGIE CFO Pierre-François Riolacci said high European energy prices weighed on gas volumes, including large-customer sales, in Q3. He expects consumption to fall further over winter.
: ENGIE CEO Catherine Macgregor said momentum for U.S. data-center and energy projects slowed ahead of midterm elections, with permitting uncertain pending decisions by newly elected officials.
